Catalog-first advance path (JSON stage catalog canonical, markdown transitions mirror as fallback) added locally for catalog-driven stages; upstream scripts/stelow at the pin has no catalog support. The vendored copy is data/stelow. Propose upstream; until then this entry owns the divergence.

Upstream testing guidance prescribes fail-observed guards and in-loop TDD red-green; the host forbids agent self-certification in-loop (measured harm: ProgramBench 2026 -3.6pp at +55% cost, DeepSWE 2026 zero gain). New-behavior tests are human-described or fresh-context authored/red-teamed instead. Standing policy, not a file diff.

Upstream terminality settles cards; the host keeps archiving terminal to every automated path (poll, event, drag) while reversible by exactly one human-initiated restore behind confirmation. Standing policy, not a file diff.

Upstream ask gates read strict; the host fails open on unreadable sources and checklists, and every refusal names a valid redirect (a refusal without an exit is a deadlock). Standing policy, not a file diff.
